newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won nearly flat on fears of BOK moves.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won nearly flat on fears of BOK moves.

text.p: The won was nearly flat by Tuesday's midday as fears of the central bank's dollar buying intervention kept traders on the sidelines, dealers said.
"The news report on a trade surplus in June should have been a factor for the won's rise. But fears of the central bank's intervention weighted on the market," said a foreign bank dealer.

The won closed the morning at the opening level of 888.00, against Monday's close of 887.90. It moved in an 887.80-888.30 range. Dealers said pressure for dollar sales mounted due to rising dollar supplies.
Dealers said the won would move narrowly this afternoon in the absence of fresh factors.
They said there were some exporter settlements and dollar inflows for stock investment.
